meta.pace_note: 2 NeetCode problems + 1 similar per practice day; 1 revision day every week. ~12–13 weeks to finish all 150.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.explanation: Use a HashSet while iterating. If a value is already in the set, return true. O(n) time / O(n) space.
